status: PRE-REGISTERED — frozen before any development fold was run
question: Does a market-offset residual model add out-of-sample information beyond the de-vigged opening 1X2 market, per league?
why_new: The only prior market-offset attempt (LogOddsResidualWrapper, PR #228) never ran: it read DevigResult.fair_probs (the field is .probabilities) and fell through to a uniform margin on every row, and read log-odds from legacy slot positions. Prior market work (items 62, 68, 76) scored free-covariate logits on probabilities, not a K-1 log-ratio offset.

data.exclusion_method: fd_*_2526.csv files are never copied into load_matches' input directory; the run aborts if a 2526 row appears

excluded_league.EREDIVISIE: no season before 2526 exists in the corpus

benchmark.definition: the promotion gate's market_baseline: first complete B365 pre-match triple, else Pinnacle pre-match (_parse_odds_row); proportional de-vig
benchmark.sensitivity: Shin de-vig of the same odds (src/models/evaluation/market_baseline.py devig), benchmark only

parametrisation: away is the reference class: z_home = m_home + x.b_home, z_draw = m_draw + x.b_draw, z_away = 0, where m = log(p_market_k / p_market_away); p = softmax(z). Simplex-preserving by construction.

covariates.elo_difference: compute_elo_training_columns over the loaded corpus; emitted pre-match, updated strictly after
covariates.form_difference: mean league points over each team's last 5 league matches strictly before the match date, home minus away
covariates.standardisation: training-fold mean and standard deviation only
covariates.excluded_on_purpose: shots and xG: production has no shots feed and no current-season xG, so they could not be served

candidates.R2_longshot: x = [1, m_own] (4 parameters): home equation uses m_home, draw equation uses m_draw
candidates.R3_residual: R2 plus standardised elo_difference and form_difference in both equations (8 parameters)

fit.pooling: one model pooled across the five leagues
fit.objective: mean multinomial negative log-likelihood + 0.5 * l2 * sum(non-intercept parameters^2) / n
fit.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize L-BFGS-B, gtol 1e-9, maxiter 1000, zero initialisation

folds.train: every eligible row with season earlier than the test season

metrics.paired_delta: candidate RPS minus M0 RPS per row
metrics.ci: 95% percentile interval from a cluster bootstrap over ISO calendar weeks (weeks resampled with replacement), 2000 replicates, seed 42

decision_rule.promising: pooled development delta (all four folds, all five leagues) has a CI upper bound below zero
decision_rule.selection: among promising candidates, the lowest pooled development RPS; ties go to fewer parameters
decision_rule.if_none_promising: report the negative result; the 2526 confirmation is NOT run and 2526 stays unread
decision_rule.confirmation: only for a selected candidate: refit on 1920-2425, score 2526 once per league including Eredivisie with the pooled model; a league passes iff its CI upper bound is below zero
decision_rule.no_retuning: no candidate, covariate, penalty or fold may be added or changed after this file is hashed; a change requires a new protocol version
